title: Mosaic Selfie
description: A blue-skinned woman with purple hair and a patterned headscarf sits on a bed taking a selfie with a smartphone. The central realistic painting is framed by a broken mosaic tile border featuring sun rays, blue and orange fragments, and a floral bottom panel.
prompt: A surreal painting of a blue-skinned woman with long purple hair wearing a patterned headscarf and orange-blue bikini, sitting on a bed and taking a mirror selfie with her smartphone, her face and body covered in white markings. The central image is framed by a shattered mosaic of blue, orange and yellow tiles with a large sunburst stained-glass panel at the top and an orange flower pattern at the bottom, cracked tile effect, detailed, artistic composition
